results.text: Evaluation of the Efficacy of Intravenous Infusion of 1000 mg Paracetamol as Intrapartum Labor Analgesia. It is vital to assess methods of reducing the most severe labor pain. Paracetamol infusion is an efficient therapy available to eliminate labor pain in the active phase. The present study aimed to assess the efficacy of intravenous infusion of 1000 mg paracetamol as an intrapartum labor analgesic.
